ABOUT ZFIN GPT

The Missing Layer Between Your Financial Software & AI Automation

We build open MCP infrastructure so AI agents like Claude & Zia can safely read, act, and automate inside the financial tools your business already runs.

OUR STORY

Built for the systems businesses already run on.

ZFin GPT (Zoho Finance Generative Pre-trained Transformer) exists because most of the software running enterprises today (inventory systems, finance tools, internal dashboards, CRMs) was never built with AI in mind. Replacing it isn't realistic, and waiting years for it to catch up isn't either. So we built a different path: infrastructure that sits on top of what you already have, using the open MCP (Model Context Protocol) standard, so AI agents like Claude & Zia can read, understand, and act inside your existing systems safely and immediately.

Same systems. Same software. A new layer that makes them AI-ready.

Bridging the AI Infrastructure Gap

Enterprise tools possess rich financial data and REST APIs, but lack native MCP context protocols for AI reasoning. ZFin GPT bridges this without code migration.

[Legacy REST / Zoho API] ──▶ [ZFin GPT MCP Layer] ──▶ [Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Zia]
OUR METHODOLOGY & VALUES

What We Believe

Start with what works.

We don't tell companies to throw away software they spent years configuring. We add the AI layer on top.

Humans stay in control.

Every automation defaults to review-first: drafts, financial reports, and purchase orders wait for approval.

Standards over shortcuts.

We build on open protocols like MCP, not fragile one-off integrations that break when something changes.

Good work compounds.

We apply the same care to internal process and team culture that we apply to client work, as one shapes the other.

OUR ARCHITECTURAL PILLARS

How We Build Resilient AI Infrastructure

Core principles that guide our engineering team as we bridge legacy enterprise software with modern AI intelligence.

🌐

Open Protocols First

Built on Model Context Protocol (MCP) standards—preventing proprietary vendor lock-in and ensuring long-term software portability.

🛡️

Human-in-the-Loop

Automation with governance. Outbound emails, accounting postings, and financial runs default to review-first approvals.

⚡

Zero Rip-and-Replace

We interface directly with existing REST endpoints and database layers so enterprise systems become AI-ready in days, not months.

🔒

Granular Access Control

Strictly scoped API permissions, data isolation, and end-to-end audit trails ensure financial confidentiality at all times.

ABOUT ZFIN GPT FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Our Mission

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open, industry-wide standard created for AI reasoning agents. By building open MCP layers instead of proprietary lock-in scripts, your AI tools remain completely portable and future-proof.
Every automated action defaults to a review-first queue. Email responses, invoice postings, and financial reports wait for human approval before execution unless fully automated execution is explicitly enabled.
Our leadership team brings over 50 combined years across enterprise software architecture, legacy ERP integrations, student financial-aid systems, and AI deployment leadership. We have built and scaled systems for utilities, municipalities, logistics networks, and enterprise finance teams.
ZFin GPT is based in Frisco, Texas (Dallas-Fort Worth), as a venture associated with SNS System, with distributed engineering and deployment teams across North America and India providing global support.
